items.title: How it feels to handle Apple's foldable iPhone Duo
items.summary: Yahoo Finance Technology Editor Dan Howley joins Market Domination's host Josh Lipton from Cupertino, Calif., at Apple's (AAPL) headquarters to describe how it feels to use the newly unveiled foldable iPhone Duo and its features.

items.title: A foldable iPhone is nice, but Apple still needs to improve its AI user experience
items.summary: Apple (AAPL) is expected to unveil its foldable iPhone on Wednesday at its "Surprise and Shine" event. This will be CEO John Ternus's first product launch as chief executive. Sherwood News head of markets Luke Kawa and Investopedia editor in chief Caleb Silver chat with Morning Brief host Julie Hyman about their expectations for the launch.

items.title: Dan Ives Warns 10%-15% of US Data Center Projects Could Be Cut as AI Boom Faces Political Backlash, Calls It the ‘Biggest Threat’
items.summary: While Wall Street focuses on capital expenditure, Yorkville Ives partner Dan Ives argues that growing political backlash against data center buildouts is the single biggest threat to the tech revolution, following his tour of Midwest infrastructure sites.The ‘Hearts and Lungs’...

items.title: HIVE joins Google, Microsoft, and Amazon in new Canada data center pledge
items.summary: BUZZ HPC, HIVE’s AI subsidiary, signed Canada’s data center development principles alongside Google, Microsoft, AWS, Meta and Anthropic.

items.title: Star AI Researcher Is Leaving Meta
items.summary: Andrew Tulloch,  the star AI researcher who was offered a pay package worth more than $1 billion to join  Meta Platforms  last year, is leaving the company, according to people familiar with the situation.  Tulloch’s hiring was a coup for Meta and capped a frantic recruiting spree last summer, when Meta threw money at researchers to try to catch up in the race to build artificial intelligence.

items.title: Do Amazon and Alphabet's Combined $420 Billion in Capital Expenditures Make Sense?
items.summary: Amazon and Alphabet are seeing results of their spending paying off.

items.title: Multi-Category Presence Key To AI Visibility For Fintech Brands
items.summary: Fintech brands face greater challenges gaining visibility in AI-generated answers than brands in other sectors, but rank high when their product offerings span several categories.
